title: Preserved daily-log approvals and reports you can read on screen
changes: Adding or correcting a submitted daily log keeps earlier approved entries in the same week approved, including their reviewer, timestamp, comments and version. Weekly decisions apply to pending submissions; explicitly returning a fully approved week remains available for corrections.

Reports now includes expandable employee reports with daily planned tasks, actual activities, hours, status, remarks and review details, plus weekly activity/classification breakdowns and approved leave. Preview uses Reports view permission; Excel export remains optional.

Daily work logs cannot be filed for future dates, whether saved as drafts or submitted, created individually or through the existing batch function. The date picker and server enforce today in the system business timezone. Leave requests and report date filters retain their existing date ranges.
No database migration is required.

title: Cleaner controls, stable tables and automatic notifications
changes: Leaves now shows a calendar button with the month name and year, opening a grid of months and a year dropdown. The raw YYYY-MM field is no longer an editable textbox; existing calendar arrows, saved views and month limits continue to work. Explicit month links take priority over saved filters.

Active-filter tags now sit beneath the relevant filter fields, with a quieter outline style. Pages without a common filter panel keep the summary inside View options, clearing the space above module titles.

Removed the extra Expand editor and Copy buttons beneath text areas and inside SweetAlert notifications. Table rows no longer flash changed-row highlights or fade again when refreshed; other interface transitions remain available.

Notifications and informational alerts close automatically after four seconds (six seconds for errors), without OK, close, or extra helper buttons. Hovering no longer stops their timer. Action confirmations still require an explicit choice.

Choosing a month refreshes the calendar. Calendar month arrows are excluded from table pagination restoration, preventing an unexpected month jump when returning to Leaves. Keyboard controls, Escape, outside-click dismissal, mobile sizing and read-only states are supported. No database migration is required.

title: Correct weekday alignment in the leave calendar
changes: The leave calendar date range and weekday headings now use Sunday through Saturday consistently. November 13, 2026 appears under Friday.

Existing calendar layouts are aligned using each cell’s actual date, retaining leave previews, birthday cards, day selection and existing event handlers when calendar files come from different patch versions. Sunday and Saturday remain visually distinct from working days.
Working-day leave calculations and approval rules are preserved. Includes the compact View options controls from release 2026-11-12.27; no database migration is required.

title: Cleaner workspace controls
changes: The wide workspace toolbar is replaced with a small View options menu beside the page title. Refresh, Appearance, Shortcuts, saved filter views, page size and Undo remain available when needed.
The separate Data loaded just now row is removed. Update time is shown inside View options; loading, retry and new-data notices appear only when there is something to act on.
The menu supports keyboard navigation, Escape, outside-click dismissal and compact mobile layouts. This update changes presentation only and needs no database migration.

title: Your workspace, arranged your way
changes: Build your own dashboard with movable, resizable widget instances, duplicates, personal notes, checklists, shortcuts, scoped leave calendars and report periods. Add, remove, configure, undo, reset, cancel or save a layout for your account; mobile layouts stack in reading order.

Smoother sidebar, page, card, menu, dialog and expandable-tree transitions. Initial screens wait for foreground data with a 300 ms minimum; later loads use smaller status indicators and elapsed time. Measurable transfers show real transfer percentages. Device reduced motion and personal Standard, Subtle or Off settings are respected.

Consistent local date, month and time pickers use Sunday-first calendars, weekend shading, Today/Now/Clear and existing limits. Date ranges offer presets. Escape closes a picker before the editor. Existing business-week calculations are preserved.

Save filters, page sizes and named views to your account. Use active filter chips, Clear filters, favourite modules, sticky table headers/actions, column visibility and keyboard-resizable widths. Browser visits restore eligible pagination, scroll, expanded groups and selections.

Inline validation retains entered work and focuses the first invalid field. Unsaved-change guards, duplicate submission prevention, processing labels, mobile form actions, expanded text editing and opt-in recovery drafts improve entry forms. Credentials are excluded from recovery drafts.

Appearance adds larger text and personal blue, teal, violet and slate palettes. Search long dropdowns, copy supported fields, return to filtered lists, open the shortcut guide, and see read-only/unavailable explanations, refresh notices, changed-row highlights, consistent statuses and selected record context in bulk confirmations.

Notifications are grouped into expandable sections with item and unread counts on each inbox page. Account-owned workspace documents use validation, permission checks, CSRF and optimistic revisions; transactional saves protect related settings.

Existing installations: copy the affected files and run php bin/install-workspace-experience.php, or use bin/Update-WorkspaceExperience.ps1 from the extracted patch. The dated migrations retain existing preferences. See docs/workspace-experience.md for installation and the complete feature list.

title: Your dashboard, with motion across DevAtlas
changes: Customize your dashboard by showing or hiding widgets, moving them with drag-and-drop or up/down buttons, and choosing Comfortable or Compact spacing. Preview changes, Save to your account, Cancel or Restore defaults.
Dashboard layouts follow the signed-in account across browsers. Widgets continue to respect module permissions, and revision checks protect changes saved from another tab.

Shared card entrances, button/navigation transitions and dialog feedback now apply across module, authentication and documentation screens. Choose Standard, Subtle or Off motion from Customize; your device’s reduced-motion preference always takes priority.
Existing installations can enable saved preferences with php bin/install-ui-preferences.php. Module pages keep usable defaults before the dated migration is installed.

title: Function inventory reads function comments
changes: Code Review Function Inventory now reads descriptions from PHPDoc, ordinary block comments, consecutive // comments and # comments immediately above PHP functions and methods.
Function comments are found across visibility/static modifiers and PHP 8 attributes. Explicit @description, @summary, Description: and Purpose: text is recognized, including multiline descriptions.
File headers, parameter/return annotations and their continuation lines are excluded from descriptions. Description text remains limited to 500 characters and flows into the Source Inventory export.
Run a new Function Inventory scan to populate corrected descriptions. Previously saved review snapshots keep the descriptions recorded when they were generated.

title: Reorganized sidebar navigation
changes: Team Monitoring now appears immediately below Overview, keeping Team Monitoring, My Daily Logs, Leaves, Approvals and Reports together.
Data Dictionary and ERD Generator now appear under Data Management alongside Data Conversion.
The former Inventory section is named Workspace and includes Code Review, Server Inventory, Program Inventory, Call Directory and Access Links. The previous Workspace section has been removed.
Module search and the Roles & Permissions matrix follow the updated sidebar groups. Existing module access rules and page links continue to apply.

title: Data Management: Data Conversion
changes: Find Data Conversion under the new Data Management sidebar section. Upload CSV or Excel report data, validate it, preview the first five records and download a SQL Server script.

Report mode targets central_db.dbo.consol_data. Select all report worksheets or one worksheet; summary sheets are excluded. ReportCode and ReportName are required, TableName is derived, and duplicate report codes in the upload are rejected.

Report scripts insert one row at a time and skip an existing ReportCode or TableName when run in SQL Server. Generic CSV mode supports a chosen schema.table, delimiters and an optional schema snapshot for column validation.

Administrators can grant View, Create and Export access through Roles & Permissions. Uploads are private to the signed-in session and expire after one hour. Conversion generates downloadable SQL without connecting to or modifying the destination database.

title: Leave approvals grouped by employee
changes: The Leave approvals queue now uses expandable employee sections. Each name shows pending application counts by leave type, including zero counts for VL, SL, EL and ML. Other leave types appear when present.

An employee’s applications stay together on one page. Each application shows its dates, period, working-day count and total hours, with the existing Review application action. Multi-day requests count as one application.

Select applications individually or use employee and page selection controls. Up to 25 applications can be selected for one batch; larger queues clearly offer Select first 25. Employee counts refresh after approval or return.

Expand all and Collapse all make larger queues easier to scan. Existing section restrictions, Section Head self-approval rules, atomic batch approvals and the Concept 1 leave calendar continue to apply.

title: Read activity details in a collapsible date tree
changes: Team Monitoring member logs and Approvals weekly reviews now group work activities by date inside one overview popup. The latest date opens automatically; Expand all and Collapse all control the date groups.
Each activity shows its full classification and activity type, planned task, work performed, hours and status. Remarks and review comments appear when present, without opening a second entry dialog.

Date headings show activity counts and daily hour totals. Team Monitoring loads the complete Monday–Sunday week so busy dates are not split across log pages. Working-day monitoring totals retain their existing rules.
Private drafts and leave records stay outside the activity tree. Existing section visibility, weekly approval snapshots, whole-week approve/return actions and daily-log batch entry continue to apply.

title: Program Inventory sizes match Windows Explorer
changes: Program Inventory now rounds each file size up to a whole KB, matching the Windows Explorer Size column. A 7,604-byte file displays as 8 KB; an empty file displays as 0 KB.
The folder preview and Excel exports use the same rounding for local-computer and server-folder scans. Excel size cells remain numeric and display without decimals.
Preview totals add the rounded KB values shown for the included files so the total agrees with the inventory rows.

title: Approve selected leave applications together
changes: The Leave tab in Approvals now includes individual selection, Select all on this page, Clear selection and Approve selected. Up to 25 pending applications can be approved in one action.

One confirmation approves every working day in each selected application. All selected requests are checked and saved together; a changed, unavailable or invalid request prevents the whole batch from being approved.
Batch approvals retain section-only review permissions, Section Head self-approval rules, working-day validation and request version checks. Individual approval and return actions remain available.
Selections clear after refresh, page changes or a completed review so the queue always uses the latest request versions. The Concept 1 month calendar and day panel continue to work.

title: Leaves: month calendar and day panel
changes: The Leaves workspace now pairs a compact month calendar with a selected-day panel. Select any date to see its full leave list and birthdays in separate tabs.
Each date shows up to two color-coded previews and a +N more count. Busy dates keep the same height, and the full day list scrolls inside its panel.

Summary cards show people on leave on the selected day, pending leave days in the selected month, and birthdays in that month. Sunday-first weeks and distinct weekend shading remain available in Light and Dark themes.

Apply for a working day directly from the panel, open existing request details, and move between dates with the arrow keys. Existing leave types, privacy rules and section approval workflows continue to apply.

title: Compact Sunday-first leave calendar
changes: Leave calendar weeks now run Sunday to Saturday. Weekend columns have distinct shading and non-working labels in Light and Dark themes.
Calendar day cells keep a fixed height and show up to four compact leave or birthday previews, so busy dates do not stretch the whole week.
Use +N more or View day to see every leave entry and birthday for the selected date. Full names and details remain available in the day list.
Calendar date coverage includes complete Sunday-to-Saturday weeks across month and year boundaries. Working-day leave rules and approval permissions continue to apply.

title: Add a full day's logs in one form
changes: Choose one activity date and use Add another log to enter multiple work activities in the same form.
Each activity has its own classification, activity type, planned task, activity performed, hours and remarks. Remove a section before saving if it is not needed.
Save all activities as drafts or submit them together. A running activity count and total hours help you check the day before saving.
The whole submission is validated and saved together. Existing daily hour limits, individual-log editing, weekly approvals and reports continue to apply.

title: Project maintenance cleanup
changes: Removed completed migration tooling, temporary browser profiles, intermediate snapshots and download caches.
Archived unused legacy layouts, code-review reference pages and the replaced Inter font while retaining application workflows, compatibility routes, uploads and installation recovery files.

title: Clean application URLs
changes: Module navigation now uses extensionless CodeIgniter URLs.
Existing .php page bookmarks redirect to the clean location and preserve filters and query parameters.
Legacy API and form submissions remain supported with the same permissions and CSRF protection.

title: CodeIgniter foundation and readable views
changes: Moved module pages and endpoints into CodeIgniter 4 controllers and views while preserving existing links, permissions and workflows.
Added local HTMX record-search fragments, Alpine shared controls and compiled Tailwind styling. Light, Dark and System modes remain available.
Formatted first-party view templates with aligned HTML tags and repeatable formatting checks. Installed libraries, plugins and generated assets are excluded from source reviews.

title: Leave ranges, unified approvals and calendar birthdays
changes: Leave applications now accept Date From and Date To. Weekends and organization holidays are excluded, and one approval covers the whole working-day range.
Approvals is a separate module with Daily Logs and Leave tabs. Each keeps its own permissions and review rules; the leave calendar contains application controls.
User creation and editing now include an optional Birthday field. Birthdays appear annually on the department calendar without exposing birth years or ages.
Department visibility, section-only leave approval, Section Head self-approval, existing leave history and report totals are preserved.

title: Department leave calendar and section approvals
changes: Leave and undertime applications now have their own Leaves module with a department calendar, personal requests and a section approval queue.
Personnel can see submitted and approved leave across their department. Application remarks are limited to the applicant and authorized section approvers.
Grant Leaves Review to a chosen role in Roles & Permissions. Approvers are restricted to their own section, and Section Heads may approve their own leave.
Weekly daily-log approval now covers work activities only. Existing leave records, team hour totals and report exports are preserved.

title: Edit submitted daily logs
changes: Personnel with Daily Logs Edit permission can now update their own submitted work and leave entries while awaiting weekly approval.
Submitted entries use Save Changes and remain submitted. Reviewers must refresh a changed weekly snapshot before approving; reviewed entries remain locked.
Existing ownership, record version, working-day and daily-hour validation still apply. Deleting entries remains limited to Draft and Returned logs.

title: QMS standards and maintenance checks
changes: Applied QMS source headers, naming, vertical braces, four-space layout and separate statements throughout first-party modules and shared code.
Moved static inline module styles into an external stylesheet and separated metadata connection setup from catalog processing.
Installation secrets now use authenticated encrypted local configuration. Existing connection values and the vault key are preserved.
Added repeatable QMS audits, module validation reports and matching named migration logs. Existing database and API names remain compatible.
Corrected QMS diagnostics for nested JavaScript templates, boolean expressions, markup and logical switch indentation.

title: Larger project reviews and activity guidance
changes: Code Review now scans up to 3,000 supported source files from a computer or server folder, with a 48 MB total source allowance and the existing 256 KB per-file limit.
Large project reviews continue to save their history and export to Excel or ODS. Existing folder exclusions and displayed finding limits apply.
All 20 Activity Types now show their full reference descriptions directly below the selector when adding or editing daily logs.

title: Your next actions, reminders and record search
changes: The dashboard now prioritizes missing hours, returned logs, pending employee-week approvals, section completion and renewals.
Daily-log and weekly-approval digests run on working days with configurable timing, lookback and approval delay. New log-reminder email is off by default.
Search workspace finds personnel, servers, dictionary tables and fields, ERDs, saved reviews, contacts, links and your own daily logs. Results follow permissions and section scope.
Dashboard actions and search results open the relevant record or filtered workflow. Applications and Requirements remain hidden.

title: Consistent typography, icons and feedback
changes: Poppins typography is applied across the interface using locally hosted font files.
Lucide is the shared icon library for navigation, controls, empty states and feedback.
SweetAlert2 now provides confirmations and notifications across all modules, with Light and Dark appearance.
Confirmation actions wait for your decision and remain accessible above open editors.

title: Poppins typography
changes: Poppins is now the interface font across DevAtlas, including navigation, forms, dashboards and documentation.
Font files are hosted locally and work in Light, Dark and System appearance.

title: Introducing DevAtlas
changes: The system is now DevAtlas, with a modern enterprise IT management identity.
A unified electric-blue, navy and cyan design covers the dashboard, modules, sign-in and documentation.
Choose Light, Dark or System appearance. System follows your device and responds when its color preference changes.
Inter typography and Lucide icons are bundled locally. Existing data, approvals, exports, permissions and workflows are retained.
The login page now presents a DevAtlas workspace overview, with Call Directory and Quick Links in the header. Email sign-in and recovery no longer display protected-email fallback messages.
Appearance controls are in the account menu and standalone-page footers, keeping headers focused.
Applications and Requirements are temporarily hidden from navigation, search and the permission matrix. Existing data and grants are retained.

title: Head approvals, standalone help and update history
changes: Holidays is now in the Parameter sidebar group and permission-matrix group.
Section Head and Department Head roles can approve their own submitted employee weeks. Reviewing other employees still requires a section reviewer assignment.
Documents Wiki now opens as a separate page from the top-bar Help menu and no longer appears in the sidebar.
What's New opens in a modal with newest-first history. It appears for each new release and remembers dismissal for each user.

title: Module guides and the organization holiday calendar
changes: Added searchable guides for every module and a roadmap separating delivered features from planned work.
Moved Holidays into a separate module with organization-wide dates, a year filter and administrator editing.
Grouped Users, Organization, Roles & Permissions and Parameters under Parameter in the sidebar and permission matrix.
